N0_label_permuted.description: Preserve graph topology; permute semantic labels on carriers and transformations.
N0_label_permuted.purpose: Detect if apparent structure is label-dependent rather than topological.

N1_degree_preserving.description: Preserve in/out degree sequence while rewiring compatible edges where possible.
N1_degree_preserving.purpose: Detect if structure exceeds degree sequence constraints.

N2_type_relaxed.description: Ignore carrier types while preserving arrow count.
N2_type_relaxed.purpose: Detect if typing is load-bearing for any claimed pattern.

N3_fate_permuted.description: Preserve graph and consumer counts; permute fate statuses.
N3_fate_permuted.purpose: Detect if fate profiles are specially arranged.

N4_hierarchical_nonfractal.description: Construct nested or branching graph with no scale-invariant self-similarity (e.g., simple tree of depth 3 with distinct labels).
N4_hierarchical_nonfractal.purpose: Determine whether test merely detects hierarchy or nesting.

execution_note: On the frozen small typed graph (5 carriers, 2 components), all nulls produce comparable modularity scores; FDHT structure is not distinguishable from hierarchical nonfractal nulls under the frozen criteria.
